'NativeSobolevBoundary.jets_exhaust' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'NativeSobolevBoundary.exact_boundary_split' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'NativeSobolevBoundary.completed_boundary' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'NativeSobolevBoundary.exact_boundary_split' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
NativeSobolevBoundary.exact_boundary_split (m : ℕ) {s t : ℝ} (hst : s ≤ t) :
  m - NativeSobolevBoundary.jets m s =
    m - NativeSobolevBoundary.jets m t + (NativeSobolevBoundary.jets m t - NativeSobolevBoundary.jets m s)
